title: land's no-work-rows warning tells a late row from a missing one and names an undelivered store
goal: backlog.py land's warning after a landing with no work rows says whether a worker session of the item is still open or undistilled in the spool (rows late) or none exists (missing), names a store a session end left unpushed, and is not printed when a worker row of the item (branch, agent-start or agent-stop) exists.

gates.question: How does land treat a worker row in the spool, given the goal says both 'tell rows late' and 'not printed when a worker row exists'?
options: a land: note, no warning (warning only for missing and undelivered)
gates.recommendation: a land: note, no warning (warning only for missing and undelivered)
gates.answer: a land: note, no warning (warning only for missing and undelivered)
